subject.title: Support session-level environment variables for ACP sessions

question: Should OpenClaw expose a per-spawn `sessions_spawn.env` API for ACP sessions, and if so what validation, redaction, source-of-trust, and interaction with per-agent/per-call env designs should it require?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the requested API can carry credentials into host ACP subprocesses and overlaps active env-surface designs, so automation should not choose the permanent security/product boundary.

options.title: Approve a credential-safe ACP env contract
options.body: Define a narrow, validated, redacted per-spawn ACP env API and require implementation across schema, spawn, manager, ACPX, docs, and tests.

options.title: Fold into broader env design
options.body: Defer this issue to the per-agent or per-call sandbox env proposals if maintainers want one shared env injection model instead of a dedicated ACP spawn parameter.

options.title: Reject model-callable raw env
options.body: Close or narrow the request if maintainers decide that per-spawn env maps are too risky and users should use configured agents or external orchestration instead.

recommendation.title: Approve a credential-safe ACP env contract
recommendation.body: Define a narrow, validated, redacted per-spawn ACP env API and require implementation across schema, spawn, manager, ACPX, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged ACP thread-bound session work introduced the core ACP spawn/session surface that the decision would extend.
